name: sitrep-reporter
description: Reports this Claude Code session (model, effort, plan, agents, context, git, failures) to a SITREP server, and takes answers sent from it.

serverUrl.title: SITREP server URL
serverUrl.description: Where the reporter posts session reports.

token.title: SITREP token
token.description: The server's admin secret, sent with every report and request. Leave empty when the server has none.

flushIntervalMs.title: Report interval (ms)
flushIntervalMs.description: Minimum time between reports while something changes.

heartbeatMs.title: Heartbeat (ms)
heartbeatMs.description: Report at least this often even when nothing changed.

sessionName.title: Session name
sessionName.description: Display name for this machine's sessions. Usually left empty.

showStatus.title: Status line
showStatus.description: The reporter's state under the prompt: 'dashboard v<the dashboard's version> ● N live', or '○ connecting', '○ offline', '○ token refused' or '○ report rejected' in place of the count; after the count, '· update plugin' or '· update server' when the versions do not fit, '· update available' when a newer plugin exists.

fullPrompts.title: Send full prompts and answers
fullPrompts.description: Send each agent's whole task prompt and final answer (up to 20,000 characters each, secrets redacted) so the dashboard can show them in full. Off by default: only the first 400 characters are sent.

activityFeed.title: Send recent activity
activityFeed.description: While the dashboard has an agent's or the orchestrator's panel open, send that loop's recent tool calls and the text it writes between them (the last 20, each cut to 300 characters, secrets redacted). A Bash call also carries its whole command (up to 20,000 characters, secrets redacted) and how it ended; command output is never sent. The server keeps it in memory only. Needed for answering from the dashboard. On by default.

respond.title: Answer from the dashboard
respond.description: What this session accepts from the dashboard. off: nothing. questions: answers to questions, and new messages while idle. questions-and-plans: the above, plus approving or sending back a plan. everything: the above, plus allowing or denying a tool (allow once only), and /clear, /compact. Needs 'Send recent activity' on too, and the server's respond setting. The default is everything.
